name: Hound -Juuyoku no Baishuusha-
source:
Yukito is an elite banker. One day, he is ordered to save a high-class Japanese-style restaurant that the bank lent a lot of money before. Great chance for him to be the president of his bank. "Ok, I'll surely make it..."

[From ErogeShop]
